answer: To resist sybil attacks an agent economy can force every identity to lock a refundable bond inside an umber dune of shared escrow. The bond stays locked until the agent produces a unique lotus of attested work over several epochs. An attacker who fabricates dozens of identities must immobilize capital equal to N times the bond size; detection of coordinated duplicates triggers full slashing of all those bonds, so the cost scales linearly with the number of sybils while honest participants only temporarily forgo liquidity.
